research_question: Can a causal cost-covering breakeven stop improve S108 after a confirmed favorable move without changing its entries, initial liquidity-sweep stop or target?
selection_disclosure: S111 was designed after S110 path diagnostics showed that some losing positions first exceeded +1R. The 1R threshold is a conventional predeclared risk rule, but every historical result is selection-contaminated and diagnostic.

data.source: the checksum-verified archives and global-regime construction used by S108

frozen_change.entries: FailedAuctionConfig() and all S108 entry, sizing, initial-stop, target, time-stop and cost rules are unchanged.
frozen_change.management_clock: Only fully completed 15-minute candles are observed. A decision computed at the candle close is active from the next 5-minute candle.
frozen_change.trigger: When a completed 15-minute close is at least +1.00 initial price-R from the slipped entry, move the stop once to the exact cost-covering breakeven price.
frozen_change.cost_breakeven: The stop price covers entry fee and slippage plus exit fee and slippage under the active cost scenario.
frozen_change.no_extra_profit_management: No partial exit and no chandelier/trailing stop. The original target remains unchanged. The stop is never widened.

predeclared_historical_gate.signal_regression: The nine raw S108 signals and their setup IDs must reproduce exactly.
predeclared_historical_gate.sample: At least 18 stress fills and at least five fills in each direction.
predeclared_historical_gate.improvement: Stress and severe PnL must each exceed S108 by at least $0.25; stress PF must exceed S108 and stress DD must not exceed S108.
predeclared_historical_gate.direction: Long and short stress PnL must each be non-negative.
predeclared_historical_gate.time: At least three of four stress slices positive and no stress slice below -$0.50.
predeclared_historical_gate.uncertainty: Deterministic circular 28-day bootstrap p10 terminal PnL must exceed the S108 reference p10.
predeclared_historical_gate.promotion: Passing every check can start paper-forward observation only. Live remains disabled.

claim_policy: No historical result guarantees profit. No parameter may change after this protocol is hashed and before the frozen replay completes.
